slots.name: start-window
slots.caption: The RNAtwine window with a design open, with (1) the rail, (2) the 3D view under its toolbar, (3) the side panel and (4) the status line, as the list below describes them.

slots.name: start-first-relax
slots.section: A first relax in five steps
slots.caption: A tile after a relax, with This run open in Inspect and the label under the view reading RELAXED with the number of the run.

slots.name: start-settings
slots.caption: The Settings window, where you set how many CPU cores a relax uses.

slots.name: open-library
slots.caption: The Open step showing the design library.

slots.name: open-formats
slots.caption: The Open... button and, under it, the list of the kinds of file that RNAtwine reads.

slots.name: open-import
slots.caption: The Import structure window for a deposited structure.

slots.name: open-drawn
slots.section: What you see when a design opens
slots.caption: A newly opened design, drawn as pyFuRNAce drew it, with handles on the loops that need a role.

slots.name: build-setups
slots.caption: The Build start screen, with the design's saved setup above the cards.

slots.name: build-loops
slots.caption: The Kissing loops table, where a loop that the drawing leaves open waits under Needs a decision with (1) its role switch, (2) its isomer toggle and (3) its drawn gap, and the loops drawn closed are folded below.

slots.name: build-handles
slots.caption: Loop handles over the view. A filled sapphire disc marks a loop that closes, a hollow disc one left open, a gold disc one that joins copies, and a dashed disc with a question mark one that still needs a role. The loop under the pointer shows its role and a dashed arc to its other half.

slots.name: build-copies
slots.caption: The Dimer, ring or chain setup, with (1) the number of copies, (2) the topology and (3) the site that each joined site pairs with on the next copy.

slots.name: build-lattice
slots.caption: The Tube or sheet setup.

slots.name: build-blocks
slots.caption: The From runs setup, with relaxed runs as blocks, the joins between the blocks, and Place.

slots.name: build-relax-progress
slots.caption: A relax in progress.

slots.name: inspect-this-run
slots.caption: The This run page, with the metrics of the run on screen and its kissing loops.

slots.name: inspect-drawn-relaxed
slots.caption: A relaxed run with Drawn chosen in the toolbar, showing the shape the relax started from.

slots.name: inspect-card
slots.caption: The card of a selected paired nucleotide.

slots.name: inspect-flexibility
slots.caption: A relaxed structure colored by flexibility.

slots.name: inspect-runs
slots.caption: The Runs page with the session's runs, and the comparison of two of them that compare to opens.

slots.name: inspect-compare-structure
slots.caption: A relaxed tile compared with its deposited structure, drawn over the model and colored by distance.

slots.name: inspect-compare-map
slots.caption: A relaxed model fitted into a cryo-EM density map.

slots.name: inspect-relax-into-map
slots.caption: Relax into map under the comparison with a density map, filled in, with the resolution typed, since the map states none, and the hand set to the mirror image.

slots.name: inspect-map-run
slots.caption: The run relaxed into the map, colored by its distance to the density, with the later lines of its relax into map block and the form grayed, since this run is itself relaxed into the map.

slots.name: inspect-thermal-motion
slots.caption: Thermal motion of a relaxed structure, swinging along its softest collective motions.

slots.name: edit-save
slots.caption: Saving the edited design as a new folder beside the original.
